question.problem: Given that  ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14122164/assets/b489811024ece2341b91e0b9819714a988cf31a87598601a8a1257c02129698c.svg) find a basis for $\textrm{Null}(A).$
question.worked_solution:
Any vector in $\textrm{Null}(A)$ has the form

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14122164/assets/94af7adea734ab0f38b5f8521fcf575cbc263cc1700a3144f682706711604859.svg)

Expanding, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{3}-{x}_{4} \\ 4{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3} \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{3} \\ 4{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{4} \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ {x}_{4}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{4}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 0 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, a basis for $\textrm{Null}(A)$ is

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14122164/assets/4a8f749660a2c8b71cd9fe61c97180fd143a3c06c754e75a1dc51c14622f03a2.svg)

since it is a linearly independent set and its vectors generate $\textrm{Null}(A).$
